name: EPA ECHO SOBE (New Mexico permits)
operator: US EPA Region 6 (permitting authority for New Mexico)
access_detail: Daily ZIP from ECHO (no auth). On 2026-11-07 the current-version ZIP (Last-Modified 2026-11-05) held only its metadata, so the module reads the current version of each report from the all-versions ZIP (2026-11-04 extract). 2 reports under New Mexico permits, both the Town of Taos's (NM0024066): 2026-02-19 private-sewer overflow (50 gallons) and 2026-10-16 manhole overflow (2,000 gallons). 4 Navajo Nation reports located in New Mexico: Shiprock (NN0020621) 3, 2024-06 to 2025-11, and one Window Rock (NN0021555) line break just east of the state line, 2026-08. 55 New Mexico permits and 5 Navajo Nation permits located in New Mexico are in EPA's collection-system table.
cadence: daily ECHO file; a median 4 days from start to receipt on the six New Mexico reports (one anticipated bypass notice filed the day before)
history: 2024-06 to 2026-10 (New Mexico-located reports); New Mexico permits 2026 only
status_reason: Read by the national eRule module (echo-sewer-overflow) with New Mexico in its states since 2026-11-07: the only machine-readable record of New Mexico overflow reports, though only the Town of Taos files and the Navajo Nation's Shiprock plant files under its own permit.
notes: 2026-11-04 extract: 6 reports located in New Mexico; 1 kept as reaching a water (Shiprock's anticipated bypass of 2024-06-15 to 06-22, 300,000 gallons, receiving water San Juan River), 5 dropped (4 with no evidence the sewage reached a water, 1 naming only the plant's emergency lagoon). Times carry no zone: read as America/Denver. One Taos report gives 18:10 for a release its description puts at 1:10pm (five hours apart); one Shiprock report gives its longitude without the minus sign (read as west).

name: NMED Surface Water Quality Bureau HABs Mapper (current HAB advisories) feature service
access_detail: Behind ArcGIS Experience 6329d5b4c47045b59bd52275bbf23a75 (page NMED-HABs-Mapper) linked from env.nm.gov/surface-water-quality/hab/. Layer edited 2026-10-30; 40 rows. A historic table service also exists (2026_05_27_HABs_historic_data_example). Sample research/nm/raw/nmed-hab-current-sample-2026-11-03.json. The layer name (Upload_Data_May2026) suggests a new service per season; resolve the URL through the Experience each time.
cadence: updated every one to three weeks in season (uploads 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-23 seen)
status_reason: Read through the generic ArcGIS ingester (fetch block in its source file): one record per station and sample date under a WATCH, WARNING or DANGER status; the layer's own coordinates; blooms, not sewage.
notes: 2026-11-07 fetch: 40 stations (26 MONITORED, 8 WATCH, 6 WARNING; WARNING at Eagle Nest Lake, Quemado Lake, El Vado Reservoir, Bluewater Lake, Charette Lake and Clayton Lake); layer last edited 2026-10-30. Last_Monitored is text in several date forms.
